description: 3-site Hubbard model, open boundary conditions, t=1.0, U=3.7. Spin-orbital ordering: site0-alpha, site0-beta, site1-alpha, site1-beta, site2-alpha, site2-beta.
convention: one_body_integrals: spatial orbital basis h[p,q]. two_body_integrals: physicist notation <pq|rs> in spatial orbital basis. Spin-orbital integrals derived via h_spin[p,q] = h_spatial[p//2,q//2] * delta(p%2, q%2); g_spin[p,q,r,s] = g_spatial[p//2,q//2,r//2,s//2] * delta(p%2,r%2) * delta(q%2,s%2). The full Hamiltonian is H = nuclear_repulsion + sum_{pq} h[p,q] a†_p a_q + 0.5 * sum_{pqrs} g[p,q,r,s] a†_p a†_q a_s a_r (spin-orbital indices, normal-ordered two-body term).
